author: Clijmart
body:
Heyo,
some may be thinking, 'Stop mapmaking, your maps aren't original anymore!'.
Well, here we got some original gameplay!

Map Info:
Long but thin map with lots of tactics and strategies to be discovered.
Has 2 monuments and 1 wool room, for each team. (This map is made for Atlas!)
Multiple portals to different locations, at spawn.
Team names: Bright vs Dark (Light blue vs Dark blue)

Links:
Timelapse: https://youtu.be/RhPjfZhzo0k
Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/XScut
XML: Coming soon!
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/86738ac4ck6bu5a/Portals_%5BDTM_CTW%5D.rar

Hope you're as excited as I am!
Leave your feedback down below <3

- Clijmart

replies.author: Clijmart
replies.body:
Ill change the team colors, thanks for telling me.

The woolroom is hanging below the spawn island, with the curved lane going in front of it.

Since there are multiple portals which the players can use to get to different spots, the only briges needed, are the ones in the middle of the map, and the gaps aren't too big. I think it won't even get close to a skybridge map, but that's why it needs to be tested :P

Thanks for the feedback, I'll try to add some pvp space.
